jobs: build standalone source text for a pivot
embed current pivot settings as literal config
summary: Takes the current pivot settings and returns a string of source for a standalone function that maps rows to pivoted rows. The generated function needs nothing from the page, and it skips rows whose measure will not parse, as the live pivot does.

jobs: save the pivot as a host recipe
name the recipe from its grouping columns
summary: Does nothing unless the host has supplied a save callback. Otherwise it passes the host a recipe holding the pivot's source, a generated name, the columns it reads, and plain descriptions of its effect and expected input.

jobs: save the active tab as a host recipe
list the columns a tab outputs
summary: Does nothing without a save callback or an active tab. Otherwise it passes the host the tab's source, its name or a default name, and the column names of its first output row, with no input description.

jobs: toggle a group-by dimension on or off
cap group-by dimensions at four
summary: A column already on the column axis is removed through the column remover instead. Otherwise the column is added to or taken from the group-by list, additions stop at four, and the pivot is redrawn.

jobs: set the pivot measure column
reset aggregate to count without a measure
summary: Sets the measure column, and clearing it switches the aggregate to a row count. Choosing a measure while the aggregate is a count changes it to sum, and the pivot is then redrawn.

jobs: roll rows into a nested tree of totals
tally values across column keys
skip rows whose measure does not parse
flag whether parent totals add up
summary: Takes the rows and returns the nested totals for the group-by levels, the column keys seen, a count of skipped rows, and a flag saying whether parents equal the sum of their children. A row whose measure will not parse is skipped and counted, never added as zero, and only sum and count are flagged as partitions, since average, minimum and maximum do not add up.

jobs: add one value into a running total
count the rows that reach a total
summary: Adds one value to a node's row count and to its running figure, which is a sum, minimum or maximum depending on the aggregate. The first value sets a minimum or maximum directly rather than being compared against an empty start.

jobs: add one value into a column cell
summary: Finds or creates the cell for a column key on a node and folds the value into it the same way as a node total. A cell exists only once a row has reached it, so a key never seen is left unset rather than set to zero.

jobs: turn a total into a display record
round a total to display precision
sort children largest first
summary: Converts a tree node into a display record with its label, a row-count note, its value rounded to the display precision, its row count, its position among siblings before sorting, its cells, and its children sorted largest first. An average is the sum divided by the row count, and a cell the node never reached stays empty.

jobs: flatten the pivot tree into table rows
put column keys before the total
summary: Takes the result of the tree computation and returns one table row per node, in depth-first order. Each row carries its level, the path of group values in one column per group-by dimension, its row count, a column per column key, and a total, which comes last when column keys exist and otherwise takes the measure's name.

jobs: add a row for each tree node
fill group-by cells from the path
summary: Adds a row for a node, filling each group-by column with the path value at its depth and leaving it blank beyond that depth, then fills the row count, the cell values and the total. It then recurses into the children in their stored order.

jobs: build the report layout from the pivot
render the report when layout is shown
summary: When the layout view is showing and the report is ready, it builds the report model from the pivot result using the group-by levels, a band if there are two column dimensions, the measure label and the chosen order, and renders it to markup. Otherwise it clears both the model and the markup.

jobs: recompute the pivot for the active tab
send the flattened pivot to the viewer
refresh the report layout
summary: Computes the pivot tree from the active tab's rows, flattens it, and stores both. With no rows it clears the output and sends an empty list; otherwise it sends the flattened rows to the viewer, which shows that one shape in every mode, and then refreshes the report.

jobs: reset the workbench to empty
save cleared tabs and notify the host
summary: Returns the workbench state to its empty defaults, resets the tabs to one identity tab, saves them, tells the host about an empty ingest if it listens, and shows a blank table in the viewer.

jobs: download the current export as a file
summary: Builds the export text for the current output view and saves it as a file with the matching extension, through a temporary link. The object URL is released 100 milliseconds later.

jobs: draw batch chips that choose the data scope
offer run and clear beside the chips
draw the paste or drop target
summary: The first part of the panel markup holds the narrow-screen style rules, a row-count readout, the batch chips that choose which data the views describe, the combine and tag-column controls, run and clear, and the paste or drop area for new data. It stops where the transform editor card begins.

jobs: draw the transform tab strip and editor
draw the dimension finder for picking keys
summary: The second part of the panel markup finishes the transform tab strip with close, add and recipe controls, then the wrap, copy and save buttons and the code editor with its error line. It also draws the dimension finder: a column list where a person includes columns or makes them keys, and a list of candidate keys to preview or add.

jobs: draw output view and export buttons
draw pivot grouping and measure controls
summary: The third part of the panel markup draws the output view buttons, the three display-mode buttons, and the copy and download buttons. It then draws the pivot controls: group-by chips that can be dragged to reorder, a column-axis row, a pool of unused columns, the measure and aggregate choices, a reset, and the function line with its copy button.

jobs: draw report layout with copy and order
draw bundle pane with key checklist
summary: The last part of the panel markup draws the save-as-recipe button, the dimension preview banner, the viewer with its not-yet-run messages, and the report layout with its copy and order controls. It also draws the bundle pane with its key checklist and preview, then closes the outer markup.

jobs: expose the explorer and profiler as globals
summary: Takes no input. When run, it defines the shared helpers and the profiling and explorer objects inside its own scope, then attaches those two objects to the page's global object so other code can profile a table or build an explorer.

jobs: create an element with attributes and children
summary: Takes a tag name, an attribute map and any number of children, and returns a new element. Text and markup set the content, function-valued on-attributes become lowercase event listeners, and null or false attributes and children are left out.

jobs: parse a financial number string
read parenthesized values as negative
summary: Takes a number or a string and returns a finite number, or null for anything that is not numeric. Commas, currency symbols, percent signs and spaces are removed, and a value wrapped in parentheses is negative.

jobs: format a number with thousands separators
show negatives in parentheses
summary: Takes a number and an optional maximum number of decimals, and returns the number grouped in thousands. Whole numbers show no decimals and other numbers show at least two, up to the maximum, and a negative number is wrapped in parentheses; a missing or non-numeric value gives an empty string.

jobs: profile every column of a table
report the share of filled cells
summary: Takes a list of row objects and optional column declarations, and returns the row count, column count, total cells, overall fill rate, a tally of column types, and a profile for each column. Declared columns keep their order and title even when no row has them, and any other key found in a row is added after them.

jobs: classify a column by its values
summarize a numeric column's distribution
list the most frequent values
summary: Profiles one column by counting its blank cells and testing each filled value as a number and as a year or date. The column is empty when nothing is filled, numeric when every filled value is a number and the column is not all years from 1900 to 2100, temporal when at least 90 percent look like years or dates, text when values average over 60 characters or are mostly distinct, and categorical otherwise. Numeric columns also get min, max, sum, mean, median, quartiles, zero and negative counts and a ten-bin histogram, every column gets its six most common values, and the distinct count stops at 2000.

jobs: build an interactive table explorer in a container
return handles to the table and profile
summary: Takes a container, rows, optional column declarations, a file name and options, and replaces the container's contents with a three-tab explorer: a data grid, a column profile and a pivot view. The grid is built only when its library is loaded, the explorer opens on the data tab with the first column selected, and the returned handles give the grid, the profile, and functions to switch views, filter by a column value, and hide empty columns.

jobs: switch the explorer to a named view
summary: Takes a view name and shows that view's panel while hiding the others and marking its tab. The old profile name is read as the columns view; switching to columns or pivot draws it, and switching back to data redraws the grid on the next frame.

jobs: hide or show fully blank columns
summary: Flips the hide-empty setting, then hides or shows each column that has no values in any row. It redraws the grid and refreshes the options menu so its label matches the new state.

jobs: filter the grid to one column value
summary: Takes a column name and a value, switches to the data view, clears the grid's existing filters, and sets the header filter for that column to the value. Does nothing when no grid exists.

jobs: rebuild the header action buttons
offer browse, export and workbench actions
summary: Rebuilds the icon buttons at the top right of the explorer: a button that browses the rows as cards, and a menu holding a hide-empty toggle when there are empty columns, a CSV download, and an open-in-workbench item when the host supplies one. Menu items close the menu when chosen.

jobs: open the rows as a card browser
summary: Hands the grid to the card browser when that is already loaded. Otherwise, when the swipe deck is present, it loads the card browser library first and logs a warning if the load fails; it does nothing when neither is present.

jobs: download the rows as a CSV file
summary: Closes the menu, then builds a CSV of the column titles and every row. It uses a CSV library when one is loaded and a quoting fallback when not, and downloads the file under the source's name.

jobs: build the column profile view
offer a name search on wide files
show a list and detail pane for columns
summary: Rebuilds the columns view with a header line of row, column and empty counts plus fill rate, a name search that appears only past twenty columns, a type filter when the file has more than one type, and order choices. Below these, a split pane lists the columns on one side and shows the inspector for the selected column on the other, stacked vertically on narrow screens.

jobs: build a row of single-choice pills
summary: Takes a label, a list of options with optional counts, the current choice and a callback, and returns a labelled row of single-choice pills. Choosing a pill calls the callback with its value, repaints the row, and redraws the column list.

jobs: build one pill with an optional count
summary: Builds one pill showing its text and, when present, its count. Clicking it passes its value to the callback, repaints the row, and redraws the column list.

jobs: repaint a pill row for a choice
summary: Takes a value and runs the highlighter across every pill, so only the pill whose value matches is shown as active.

jobs: style one pill as active or idle
summary: Takes one pill and its index, compares that option's value with the chosen value, and styles the pill as primary when they match or as a muted ghost button when they do not.

jobs: filter and sort the column list
keep the selected column valid
show the inspector for the selected column
summary: Redraws the column list after applying the type filter, the name search and the chosen order, using original position as the tie-break. If the selected column is filtered out it selects the first remaining column, then redraws the summary table and the inspector; with no matches it shows a message and clears the inspector.

jobs: draw one frequent value as a chip
summary: Builds one chip for a frequent value, showing the value and, unless every value in the column is unique, its count. Long values are truncated inside the chip.

jobs: fill the detail pane for one column
show completeness and summary figures
draw a histogram for numeric columns
list frequent values that filter the grid
summary: Replaces the detail pane with the selected column's name, position and type, and a fill figure with its null count. A numeric column also gets a grid of summary figures and a ten-bin histogram, any column with values gets up to six frequent values that filter the data view when tapped, and an empty column gets a note that all rows are blank. Draws nothing when no column is given.

jobs: draw one histogram bar with a tooltip
summary: Draws one histogram bin as a rounded bar whose height is its share of the tallest bin, at least two units tall. Empty bins are drawn faint, and every bar carries a tooltip with its range and row count.

jobs: build the pivot controls
set up the pivot table area
summary: Rebuilds the pivot view as a configuration bar and a scrolling table area, then draws the table. The bar offers dropdowns for the first row group, an optional second row group, the measure and the aggregate; the row groups exclude empty columns, the measure lists only numeric columns, and a file with none gets a placeholder.

jobs: build a labelled dropdown that redraws the pivot
summary: Takes a label, the current value, the options and a change handler, and returns a labelled dropdown. Changing it passes the new value to the handler and redraws the pivot table.
